referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: I have tried to pay for my order three times this morning. Each time the checkout says something went wrong. My card works on other websites, so this is very frustrating.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: I understand. Can you tell me whether the error appears before or after you confirm the payment in your banking app?

referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: After I approve it. Then the checkout sends me back to the basket. I do not know if I have been charged, and I am worried about trying again.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: Please do not make another attempt yet. I will check the payment status with our payments team and keep this case open until we confirm it.

referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: Thank you. It would help if the error message told me whether the payment went through instead of just saying something went wrong.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: I will include that feedback in the escalation. You will receive a case update once the team has checked the transaction.

referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: I am calling to say thank you. Your team helped me understand the account settings yesterday, and everything is working well now.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: Thank you for sharing that feedback. Was there anything in the explanation that you found especially helpful?

referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: The advisor used simple language, explained each step and checked that I could see the right screen. I felt listened to.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: That is good to hear. I will share the feedback with our support team.

referenceSegments.speaker: Customer
referenceSegments.text: Please do. I have no issue to report. I just wanted the team to know they made the experience easy.

referenceSegments.speaker: Agent
referenceSegments.text: We appreciate your feedback. Thank you for taking the time to call.
